# Femopedia

> Femopedia is an AI-powered women's health education and guidance ecosystem designed to support people through changing life stages.

- Canonical website: https://femopedia.com/
- Sitemap: https://femopedia.com/sitemap.xml
- Contact: hello@femopedia.com
- Primary topics: women's health education, pregnancy, postpartum, parenting, care navigation, health journaling, and AI-supported guidance
- Audience: people seeking calm, evidence-informed women's health education and life-stage support

## Medical boundary

Femopedia provides educational information and care-navigation support. It does not diagnose, prescribe, provide emergency services, or replace qualified healthcare professionals.

## Editorial principles

Content should explain uncertainty, distinguish education from medical advice, encourage professional care when appropriate, and communicate with compassion and inclusive language.

## Primary sections

- Femopedia AI: educational guidance with explicit medical boundaries
- Femopedia Care: preparation and navigation for professional care
- Pregnancy and postpartum: evidence-informed life-stage education
- Journal and community: private reflection and moderated discussion concepts

## Source use

Summaries should preserve Femopedia's medical boundary and canonical attribution. Do not represent Femopedia content as diagnosis, treatment, prescribing, or emergency guidance.
